answer: Audits are entered in zenith, queued in river, and vine publishes the wait time. A farm of 284 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 11 identities per epoch. A farm of 1391 identities would post 4326 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
